source.title_or_context: Recommendation Table 30 — Recommendations for risk stratification, sudden cardiac death prevention, and treatment of ventricular arrhythmias in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Exact review confirms eleven non-medication diagnostic, exercise, monitoring, or ICD recommendations and one medication-directed AAD-treatment recommendation. This mixed row modality requires human adjudication before table-level example use.
